<!--
This is the most valuable thing anyone can do here. Every rule currently says
`draft`, meaning the figures are estimates nobody has checked against the
issuing authority. Turning one draft into a sourced `verified` is worth more
than five new drafts.

Open this first so nobody duplicates your work, then send the pull request.
-->

**Rule:** `rules/<country>/<document>.yml`

**Applying from:** <!-- domestic, or the country code of the mission -->

## What I will check

- [ ] The renewal window — earliest and latest you may apply
- [ ] Processing time, including the worst case rather than the typical one
- [ ] The fee, and whether the amount depends on anything
- [ ] The required documents, and how long each takes to obtain
- [ ] What happens if it lapses

## Source

<!--
The issuing authority's own page. Blogs, visa agents and forum posts are useful
supporting context and are not sufficient on their own — they copy each other
and are frequently years out of date, which is the failure this dataset exists
to avoid reproducing.
-->
